rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when strength or intensity gradually becomes less.

example.english: After taking the medicine, the pain slowly began to ebb, and it was less uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 食咗藥之後，痛楚慢慢減弱，冇咁辛苦喇。
example.jyutping: sik6 zo2 joek6 zi1 hau6 tung3 co2 maan6 maan2 gaam2 joek6 mou5 gam2 san1 fu2 laa3

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written descriptions of an ability, appetite, or bodily function fading.

example.english: As people age, memory can ebb.
example.traditional: 隨着年紀增長，記憶力會逐漸減退。
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zoek6 nin4 gei2 zang1 zoeng2 gei3 jik1 lik6 wui5 zuk6 zim6 gaam2 teoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the sea or tide flows back from the shore.

example.english: After the tide began to ebb, the beach reappeared and we could walk across.
example.traditional: 退潮之後，沙灘露返出嚟，我哋可以行過去喇。
example.jyutping: teoi3 ciu4 zi1 hau6 saa1 taan1 lau6 faan2 ceot1 lai4 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 haang4 gwo3 heoi3 laa3
